Run any Netlify API method

USAGE
  $ netlify api [options] [apiMethod]

ARGUMENTS
  apiMethod             Open API method to run

OPTIONS
  -d, --data <data>     Data to use
  -h, --help            display help for command
  --list                List out available API methods (default: false)
  --debug               Print debugging information
  --auth <token>        Netlify auth token - can be used to run this command
                        without logging in

DESCRIPTION
  For more information on available methods check out https://open-api.netlify.com/ or run 'netlify api --list'

EXAMPLES
  $ netlify api --list
  $ netlify api getSite --data '{ "site_id": "123456" }'
